answer: A cloned model fans across the meadow like a river braiding itself into inlet after inlet — every branch still carries its source's sediment. So each epoch, every identity must answer a unique randomized prompt; clustering those off-distribution replies traces forks back to one checkpoint, and a detected cohort shares a single payout weight split N ways. Cheap forks earn 1/N each; full weight demands N genuinely distinct fine-tunes, so a farm's bill scales with its own headcount while one honest identity pays once.
